Non-blocking: generated tests/test_console.py:982-988 constructs Console without _environ={}, unlike the reference and several base tests (base tests/test_console.py force_terminal=True, _environ={} appears 5 times). Console.is_dumb_terminal (base rich/console.py:928-937) reads self._environ, which defaults to os.environ, so the test would fail if TERM is dumb or unknown. Base test_justify_none (line 380-383) has the same exposure, so this is a robustness nit rather than a convention violation.

evidence: Writes the OSC 0 window-title control sequence when the console is a terminal, and returns True only then (generated rich/console.py:1166-1169; rich/control.py:33)
Legacy Windows consoles set the title through set_title (generated rich/_windows_renderer.py:46-48), matching the reference
